title: Cyclic ether-based electrolyte solutions for potassium metal batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6YA00089D, Paper

Roy Heyns, Robert Markowski, Andrii Kachmar, Johannes Ingenmey, Wouter Monnens, Alexandru Vlad, Barbara Kirchner, Jan Fransaer, Koen Binnemans
Cyclic ethers as weakly coordinating solvents in electrolyte solutions promote anion-rich solvation structures, resulting in formation of stable anion-derived SEI, enabling reversible potassium metal plating/stripping on aluminum current collectors.
